class.name: my_ur_control_cpp/SwerveDriveController
class.description:
Swerve drive controller with direct ros2_control interface access. Handles inverse kinematics (cmd_vel → steering angles + drive velocities), Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse forward kinematics (all 4 wheels → vx/vy/omega), odometry computation, and optional TF publishing (publish_tf parameter).
Requires 8 command interfaces: - Revolute{1-4}_to_base_link/position (steering) - Wheel{1-4}_to_Revolute{1-4}/velocity (drive)
Requires 16 state interfaces: - Revolute{1-4}_to_base_link/position (steering feedback) - Revolute{1-4}_to_base_link/velocity - Wheel{1-4}_to_Revolute{1-4}/velocity (drive feedback) - Wheel{1-4}_to_Revolute{1-4}/position
